sections.Profile:
Stampede (1977) and its four-player counterpart Rawhide , both produced by Chicago Coin, represent some of the final machines developed by the company before its acquisition by Stern Electronics. Designed by Albin Peters, Jerry Koci, and Wendell McAdams, these electro-mechanical pinball machines feature a Western theme with notable gameplay elements such as a spinning target, captive ball, and two kick-out holes.
